name: rp
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const hit=(p,d,f)=>{const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(...p),new T.Vector3(...d));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(x=>!f||x.object.name.startsWith('main'));return h.slice(0,3).map(x=>x.object.name.replace('main:','')+'@'+x.distance.toFixed(1)).join(' | ')||'OPEN';};const o=[];for(const x of [-92,-90,-89,-88,-87,-86,-85]){o.push('x='+x+' +Z: '+hit([x,1.6,20],[0,0,1],1));}o.push('--- across ---');for(const z of [20,26,32]){o.push('z='+z+' +X: '+hit([-92,1.6,z],[1,0,0],1));}return JSON.stringify(o)})()
